title: 第9章 向天再借二十年阳寿第10章 为何羽生续命
content_zh:
陈景言却仿佛没听见何超金的叫嚣，只是静静地看着何江南：“何总，我知道您难做。但人命关天，绝非儿戏。我可以立个军令状，若苏神医的九转还魂丹能让老爷子撑过三分钟，我任凭处置，若不能......”
他顿了顿，目光锐利如刀，射向苏杰，“那这位‘国手’，又该当何罪？”
苏杰被陈景言的气势所慑，心中竟莫名一慌，但此刻骑虎难下，只能硬着头皮道：“哼，竖子狂妄！好，老夫便与你赌这一把！若老夫的丹药无效，老夫甘愿自废双手，从此退出医坛！”
他料定陈景言只是虚张声势，老爷子本就油尽灯枯，即便服药后不久离世，也可推说是病入膏肓，药力不及，断不会想到是丹药剧毒所致。
“好！一言为定！”陈景言斩钉截铁。
何伊娜心中焦急万分，却见陈景言神色笃定，不似作伪，只能在一旁暗暗祈祷。
何江南见两人都把话说到这份上，也只能点头：“也罢，事已至此，便按你们说的办。只是......若真有万一......”他话未说完，但意思已明。
苏杰不再犹豫，从随身的锦盒中取出一粒龙眼大小、通体乌黑、散发着奇异腥气的药丸，正是他所谓的“九转还魂丹”。
他小心翼翼地要去撬开老爷子的嘴。
“且慢！”陈景言忽然出声。
苏杰手一顿，怒视道：“又想耍什么花样？”
陈景言走到床前，仔细观察了一下老爷子的气色，又伸手搭在其手腕寸关尺处，闭目凝神片刻。周围众人都屏息凝神，连呼吸都仿佛停滞了。
片刻后，陈景言睁开眼，神色愈发凝重：“老爷子生机已如风中残烛，这丹药一下去，恐怕连三分钟都撑不住。何总，何小姐，这是最后机会，你们确定要让他喂药吗？”
何伊娜泪水在眼眶里打转，拉住何江南的胳膊：“爸……”
何江南看着病床上奄奄一息的父亲，又看看一脸决绝的苏杰和镇定自若的陈景言，内心天人交战。
最终，他像是下定了某种决心，闭上眼，痛苦地摆了摆手：“喂吧……”
他实在无法相信一个街头偶遇的年轻人，能胜过声名赫赫的“大国手”。
苏杰眼中闪过一丝得意，不再迟疑，迅速将药丸喂入老爷子口中，又命人端来温水送服。
时间，仿佛在这一刻凝固了。
所有人的目光都紧紧盯着床上的老爷子，以及墙上那座古董挂钟的秒针，嘀嗒，嘀嗒，每一声都像敲在众人的心坎上。

何伊娜紧张得双手合十，默默祈祷。
何超金则一脸胜券在握，时不时轻蔑地瞥一眼陈景言。
何江南夫妇脸色苍白，眼神中充满了复杂的期待与恐惧。
苏杰捋着胡须，表面镇定，实则手心也已微微出汗。
陈景言负手而立，目光平静地看着床上的老人，仿佛早已洞悉一切。
一秒，两秒，三秒……
一分钟过去了。
老爷子依旧毫无反应，呼吸似乎比刚才更加微弱了一些。
苏杰的心开始往下沉，但嘴上仍强辩：“别急，丹药起效需要时间……”
话音未落，异变陡生！
content_en:
Chen Jingyan didn't seem to hear He Chaojin's shouting, and just looked at He Jiangnan quietly: "Mr. He, I know it's difficult for you. But human life is at stake, and this is no child's play. I can issue a military order. If Dr. Su's Nine Turns Resurrection Pill can make the old man survive for three minutes, I will do whatever I want. If not..."
He paused, his eyes as sharp as a knife, and shot at Su Jie, "Then what crime should this 'national player' deserve?"
Su Jie was intimidated by Chen Jingyan's momentum, and felt inexplicably panicked. But at this moment, he was unable to get off the tiger, so he could only bite the bullet and said: "Huh, you are so arrogant! Well, I will make a bet with you! If my elixir is ineffective, I am willing to use up my hands and quit the medical field from now on!"
He concluded that Chen Jingyan was just bluffing. The old man was already exhausted. Even if he died shortly after taking the medicine, he could be presumed to be terminally ill and the medicine was not powerful enough. He would never think that it was caused by the poisonous elixir.
"Okay! It's settled!" Chen Jingyan said firmly.
He Yina was extremely anxious, but she saw that Chen Jingyan's expression was determined and did not seem to be hypocritical, so she could only pray secretly on the side.
Seeing that both of them had reached this point, He Jiangnan could only nod his head: "Well, that's it. I'll do as you say. But... if there is an emergency..." He didn't finish his words, but his meaning was clear.
Su Jie no longer hesitated and took out a longan-sized, jet-black pill that exuded a strange fishy smell from the brocade box he carried with him. It was what he called the "Nine-turn Resurrection Pill."
He carefully tried to pry open the old man's mouth.
"Wait a minute!" Chen Jingyan suddenly said.
Su Jie paused his hands and glared: "What tricks are you trying to play again?"
Chen Jingyan walked to the bed, carefully observed the old man's complexion, then put his hand on his wrist, closed his eyes and concentrated for a moment. Everyone around them was holding their breath, and even their breathing seemed to have stopped.
After a while, Chen Jingyan opened his eyes, his expression becoming more solemn: "The old man's vitality is like a candle in the wind. I'm afraid he won't be able to last for three minutes once this pill is taken away. Mr. He, Miss He, this is the last chance. Are you sure you want to give him the medicine?"
Tears welled up in He Yina's eyes, and she took He Jiangnan's arm: "Dad..."
He Jiangnan looked at his dying father on the hospital bed, then at the determined Su Jie and the calm Chen Jingyan, and there was a conflict between heaven and man in his heart.
Finally, he seemed to have made up his mind, closed his eyes, and waved his hands painfully: "Hey..."
He really couldn't believe that a young man he met by chance on the street could surpass the famous "big national player".
Su Jie's eyes flashed with pride, and without hesitation, he quickly fed the pills into the old man's mouth and ordered someone to bring him warm water.
Time seemed to have frozen at this moment.
Everyone's eyes were fixed on the old man on the bed and the second hand of the antique wall clock on the wall. Tick, tick, every sound was like a knock on everyone's heart.
He Yina was so nervous that she clasped her hands together and prayed silently.
He Chaojin looked confident of victory and glanced at Chen Jingyan disdainfully from time to time.
He Jiangnan and his wife's faces were pale, and their eyes were full of complex expectations and fears.
Su Jie stroked his beard, appearing calm, but in fact his palms were slightly sweaty.
Chen Jingyan stood with his hands behind his hands and looked at the old man on the bed calmly, as if he had already understood everything.
One second, two seconds, three seconds...
A minute passed.
The old man was still unresponsive, and his breathing seemed weaker than before.
Su Jie's heart began to sink, but he still insisted: "Don't worry, it takes time for the pill to take effect..."
Before he finished speaking, a sudden change occurred!
